title: mmt-plugin test --json result, schema_version 1
description: The result of test (docs/design/cli.md, section 6). Paths are relative to the project when inside it (POSIX separators), absolute otherwise. stages are always the five, in order; a stage the run did not reach, or did not ask for, is skipped. packets are in the order the packet tests were read. stats holds the only timing; everything else is the same on a re-run with the same inputs (the bench's numbers aside).

profile.description: The SDK profile the plugin is generated for.

build_dir.description: The directory of mmtp_<label>.so; the harness is in its test/ subdirectory, the sanitized plugin in sanitize/.

status.description: stale: build with --no-deps, when the plugin is not up to date. bench failed: advisory, the exit code is not changed.

skipped.description: Packets not run: an earlier stage failed, or --fail-fast stopped.

attributes.description: The attributes checked (an undefined one is not).

failures.description: Each mismatch: the attribute (<protocol> for the classification, <next> for the next protocol, <harness> for a crash), the expected and the actual value, as display strings.

sanitize.description: The --sanitize run; null without it, or when it did not run.

count.description: The packets run under the sanitizers: each test's packet, then its --fuzz-count truncated and random packets.

test.description: The packet test the packet comes from.

index.description: 0: the test's own packet; N: its Nth truncated or random packet for this seed.

bench.description: The --bench run; null without it, or when it could not measure (a test.bench-failed warning).

pps.description: Packets per second with the plugin: the median sample.

baseline_pps.description: The same with an empty plugin of the same id and name.

samples.description: Packets per second of each sample, in order.
